senses.gloss:
1 Approaching, meeting,
joining, juncture.
--2 Pouring out
(of rivers).
--3 Entrance into,
vanishing, disappearance; absorption,
dissolution into oneself.

अप्य a. [अपां इदं तत्रसाधु संस्कृतं वा
यत्; अद्भिः संस्कृतं P. IV. 4. 134]
1
Connected with or coming from water
Rv. 2. 38. 7; watery; consisting of,
consecrated with, water (as हविः).
--2
Obtainable.
--3 Active, connected
with sacrificial acts 1. 145. 5.

आप्य a. [अपां इदं अण् स्वार्थे ष्यञ्]
1 Watery.
--2 Obtainable, attainable
(आप्-ण्यत्).
--प्यः A class of gods.
--प्यं Ved. Confederation, alliance.

अप्यदीक्षितः N. of a celebrated
Draviḍa writer, author of works on
Alaṃkāra and other subjects and
a contemporary of Paṇḍita
Jagannātha who lived in the 16th
century (written also as अप्ययादीक्षित.).

अप्यंच् [fr. अंच्] Gone into,
reaching, hidden.

अप्यर्धं ind. Ved. Near, in the
neighbourhood.

आप्यै {c1c} A.
1 To grow fat, stout,
or full, become full, increase;
आहुत्य, प्यायते सूर्यः Y. 3. 71.
--2
[]
To make full, strengthen,
enlarge. --Caus. (-प्याययति)
1 To
make fat, full, or comfortable,
increase, enlarge; तेजसा तव तेजश्च
विष्णुराप्याययिष्यति Mb.; सैव
कांतिर्मन्मथाप्यायिता द्युतिः S. D.;
वायुभिराप्यायितशरीरः Pt. 1; Me. 44; Ms. 9. 314.
--2
To gratify, regale, satisfy, please;
आप्यायितो वचनामृतेन H. 1; K. 124,
Mv. 1, 2.

आप्यान p. p.
1 Fat, stout, robust,
strong; Bk. 5. 56, 9. 2.
--2 Pleased,
satisfied.
--नं
1 Love.
--2 Growth,
increase.

आप्यायन a. Causing fulness or
stoutness, promoting welfare.
--नं,
--ना [प्याय्-ल्युट्]
1 The act of
making full or fat.
--2 Satisfying,
refreshing, pleasing.
--3 Satisfaction,
satiety: देवस्याप्यायना भवति Pt. 1.
--4
Advancing, promoting.
--5
Corpulency, growing fat or stout.
--6
Anything which causes corpulency or
good condition.
--7 A
strengthening medicine.
--8 Pouring water on
Soma and thus causing it to swell.
--Comp.
--शील a. satisfying.

आप्यायित a.
1 Satisfied, pleased
--2 Improved; grown, increased.
--3 Stout, fat, robust.
